title: How can I work with my child's Speech Therapist to reinforce the skills developed during therapy sessions?
metaTitle: Reinforcing Speech Therapy Skills at Home with Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Pinnacle Blooms Network encourages parent-therapist collaboration to reinforce and enhance the skills learned during Speech Therapy sessions at home.
html: Working hand-in-hand with your child's Speech Therapist to build on the skills your child gains during therapy is a wonderful approach. Here at Pinnacle Blooms Network, we foster this partnership by providing regular discussions with the therapist, hands-on training sessions, and home activities. This helps you understand how to use every moment as a potential learning opportunity, enhancing your child's ongoing development.
